decisions.reason: The indoor air quality module remains a strong fit with the firm's sensing-focused modular platform, and demand from education, building monitoring and prototyping still makes continued support more likely than withdrawal.

The MQTT proxy extends software connectivity across the platform at relatively low ongoing cost, so it is strategically efficient to retain unless it is fully replaced by newer integrated software functions.

The CAN bus interface serves industrial, automotive and automation use cases that are especially relevant in Germany, although as a more niche hardware add-on it carries somewhat higher withdrawal risk than the software offering.
